thread:
marta: heads-up: planning to publish py/ts SDK 1.8.0 in today's quiet window (15:00-17:00 PT). Primary change: deprecate synchronous client APIs, add migration helpers and clear changelog entry.

sam: thanks. are we doing a shadow canary first or rolling cohorts?

marta: shadow canary for 20m (internal beta) then stagger 3 cohorts. publishing flow: canary -> cohort1 -> cohort2 -> GA. publish-bot will tag canary.

jon: release notes owner? need exact wording about timeline and sample migration code. also please verify wheel signing and npm dist-tag helpers.

tina: I have the release notes PR ready (link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/488). Added migration snippet and FAQ Q/A.

lee: ops: define pinback strategy now. If we need to revert quickly, prefer adding a stable dist-tag pointing to previous version and remove `next`/`canary`. Yank only if package integrity is bad. For pip, we keep internal mirror pinned.

sam: agreed. doc the commands in the thread for quick copy: 
```
# npm fallback
npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@1.7.4 stable
npm dist-tag rm @redwood/sdk next
# pip: upload previous wheel back to internal index
twine upload --repository-url https://pypi.internal/redwood dist/redwood_sdk-1.7.4-py3-none-any.whl
```

publish-bot: preflight: checks passed for py and ts. canary scheduled at 15:05 PT.

jon: gating thresholds proposal: hold if >0.5% install errors or >3s median latency regression vs 1.7.x in first 10m. triage owners: sam + oncall infra.

marta: sounds good. also block GA if wheel signatures fail verification. last release had HSM timeouts so monitor `signing-service` logs.

lee: confirm env var GPG_KEY_ID present in release runner and CI has access to HSM. I saw a fallback path that produced unsigned artifacts last time.

tina: confirmed GPG_KEY_ID is set in workspace `release-runner`. I triggered a dry-run signing job earlier and it completed.

sam: docs site change: remove sync-client pages and replace with migration guide. we'll deploy a banner for 10 days explaining the deprecation. schedule deploy after cohort2.

publish-bot: canary finished at 15:28 PT: 180 installs, no client errors surfaced. Scheduling cohort1 at 15:40, cohort2 at 16:10, GA at 16:40 if all green.

marta: syncing: @tina @sam please stay available for 15:35-16:15 window. If we hit any of the hold conditions open an incident room and run the pinback commands above.

tina: on standby. added a clear migration snippet with an adapter example in the PR.

jon: CI note: make sure `RELEASE_NOTES_HASH` is included in the release artifact metadata so we can trace installs back to PR. Also add feature flag to disable deprecation banner if needed.

lee: watching signing logs now 44d all wheels show signed and checksum matches.

sam: cohort1 completed fine. cohort2 started; docs banner staged.

publish-bot: cohort2 completed 16:18 PT: no regressions flagged. preparing GA tag.

marta: cutting GA tag and publishing release notes now. great work team. :tada:
